text: まずは　つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを　へらすんだ

structure.jp: つかまえる　ポケモンの　たいりょくを
structure.en: the HP of the Pokémon you'll catch

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: つかまえる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which thing is meant. つかまえる ポケモン = 'the Pokémon you're going to catch'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んだ at the end of a plain verb can be a firm way of telling someone what to do. へらすんだ = 'what you do is lower it'.
